description: Fetch text and metadata for an opinion cluster by cluster ID. Returns majority, concurrence and dissent variants with raw HTML and readable plain text, variants_completion for source coverage, and docket_enrichment. Oversized selections return outline then page responses; continue retrieval.next_cursor as cursor with the unchanged ID/sections selection until null. Obtain cluster IDs from courtlistener_search_opinions, courtlistener_lookup_citation, or docket results.

cluster_id.description: Opinion cluster ID — identifies a case decision and groups all opinion variants (majority, concurrence, dissent). Obtain from courtlistener_search_opinions, courtlistener_lookup_citation, or from docket results that link to opinions.

cursor.description: Retrieval next_cursor from the previous response. Repeat the original ID and sections/categories selection unchanged; omit to start.

sections.description: Opinion variant identifiers to select (e.g. ["opinion_12345"]). Omit for all fetched variants. Oversized selections page; keep this selection unchanged while following cursor.

name: courtlistener_get_opinion

citations.description: All known citation strings for this case.

cite_count.description: Total number of citations from other opinions.

docket_enrichment.description: Linked-docket enrichment outcome, independent of opinion text availability.

error_code.description: Sanitized MCP error code when the lookup failed.

reason.description: Safe lookup failure category, without upstream error text.

status.description: Outcome of the optional linked-docket lookup.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_cursor`: Retrieval cursor is malformed, out of range or belongs to another request. `stale_cursor`: The normalized selected source changed since the previous page. `not_found`: Cluster ID does not exist in CourtListener. `rate_limited`: 429 from CourtListener, or no request slot opened within the wait budget. `unknown_section`: A requested sections name matches no opinion variant in this cluster. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

kind.description: 'full' carries a small selected record; 'outline' pages the section catalog; 'page' carries typed rows and field-path text chunks. Bounded identity remains present throughout retrieval.

opinions.description: Fetched variants; variants_completion describes source coverage. Pages can contain partial typed variants; omitted text is recoverable through retrieval.text_chunks at original field paths.

items.description: Individual opinion variant; omitted partial fields are recoverable through retrieval.

author_id.description: Person ID of the author; null if per curiam or unknown.

download_url.description: Direct download URL for the original opinion document; null if not available.

html_text.description: Full opinion text as HTML, drawn from the best available variant (citation-linked when present); empty only when no HTML text is stored — use download_url then.

per_curiam.description: True if this is a per curiam opinion.

plain_text.description: Supplied plain text preserved exactly, or readable text derived from source markup when absent; empty if neither exists.

type.description: Raw CourtListener opinion-type code (e.g. "030concurrence"); the numeric prefix is a sort key, not part of the type. Empty when upstream recorded none.

type_label.description: Opinion type expanded to the label courtlistener_search_opinions serves for the same variant: "lead-opinion", "concurrence-opinion", "dissent", "combined-opinion", etc. An unmapped code passes through as the code itself.

retrieval.description: Caller retrieval completion, separate from upstream source completion.

next_cursor.description: Continue with cursor and the same ID/selection; null when this fetched view is exhausted.

ranges.description: Absolute source coordinates; merge typed rows by index rather than appending duplicates.

path.description: JSON Pointer into the normalized unsliced selected view.

total.description: Length of the complete normalized collection or text field.

text_chunks.description: Text omitted from partial rows/metadata, recoverable exactly using the matching ranges.

path.description: JSON Pointer of the original string field or string-array element.

text.description: Unescaped normalized substring, matching its code_points range.

retrieval_notice.description: How to continue bounded retrieval using the unchanged ID and selection.

sections.description: Section catalog in source order, including paged metadata. Only opinion_<id> names select variants; follow retrieval.next_cursor to finish the catalog and retrieve data.

items.description: A retrievable opinion variant (opinion_<id>) and its serialized byte size.

bytes.description: Serialized byte size of the section

name.description: Section identifier — pass in `sections` to retrieve it

variants_completion.description: Source-walk completion. An oversized upstream next_cursor is omitted on partial responses and recovered at /variants_completion/next_cursor through retrieval.text_chunks.

complete.description: True only when all source variants were fetched.

next_cursor.description: Remaining upstream variant cursor; null at the end.

title: Get Court Opinion
